summary: Frontend-only visual test of report pages 2-6 restructure. I opened 3 reports: Ananya (A/C/F), Rohan (B/F/D) and Meera (A/C/E). I logged in as the counsellor and also as Ananya to check the PDF. All 5 illustrations load (naturalWidth>0) on every report, and each one matches its priority area. All 6 areas a-f have their art, plus snapshot and narrative. All previous content is still there: 4 tiles, area-score-A..F with pills and scores, honest-line, narrative-text, high-items-list, stress-loop, and priority-N-activity-1/2 with 3 steps, time and 'When it helps'. No page title overlaps its image at 390, 768, 1280 or 1920. PDF download works: the file is EquiMind-Report-Ananya-Rao.pdf, the toast reads 'Report downloaded' and there are no console errors. The print container has 11 [data-pdf-page] sections and all images load in it. Mobile at 390px stacks art above text with no horizontal scroll. One real defect: on desktop (lg, 1024px and wider) and in the PDF, the radar chart is squeezed to about 250px wide and the 'Family & Future' axis label is cut off on the left, so it shows as 'amily & Future'.

ui_bugs.issue: At lg and wider (1280 and 1920) and in the print/PDF container (900px), the radar column is only about 250-262px wide. The 'Family & Future' PolarAngleAxis label runs past the SVG's left edge and is cut off, showing as 'amily & Future'. The chart is also small. It is fine at 390 and 768, where the radar is 300-353px wide.

issues: The left half (art 185px + radar 250px) feels cramped next to the 2x2 tiles. The 'Three to work on first' tile wraps into a tall narrow column. Consider grid lg:grid-cols-[1.8fr_1fr], stacking the art above the radar at lg, or a smaller label font plus a larger left/right chart margin (e.g. 60).
The snapshot illustration still has a faint crop artefact: a small circle or ring near its top-right corner, left over from the mockup crop.
The narrative text (serif, xl) is much taller than the art, leaving large empty space above and below the illustration. This is acceptable.

action_items: Fix the radar label clipping on the Snapshot page at lg and in the PDF: widen the radar column or increase the RadarChart margin left/right (e.g. 60+). Another option is to shorten the outerRadius or make the label font smaller, then check that 'Family & Future' is fully visible at 1280, 1920 and in the 900px print container.
Optional: clean up the small circle artefact on snapshot.webp.
critical_code_review_comments: In the print container, ReportPages renders a second time with the same data-testids while the export runs, so there are duplicate testids for about 1-2s. This is harmless, but tests should scope their selectors.
In PageShell, the `art` prop path and the `side` prop path are separate layouts. That is fine, but the `art` mode is now used only on pages 7+.
seed_data_creation: None. Read-only viewing; no data changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Report IDs: Ananya 6053e41d-afbf-48a4-a7c8-728d282c5838 (A,C,F), Rohan dee67d7a-258a-4c4b-b413-52225ddd3dee (B,F,D), Meera 7be0dd35-1107-4618-9912-bdca366160f6 (A,C,E). Log in with demo-login-cou-kavya to view any report. Art is in /report-art/area_{a..f}.webp. To check the radar clipping, compare each tick text's bounding box against the [data-testid=radar-chart] rect.
rca of the issue: The grid is lg:grid-cols-[1.55fr_1fr], and the left half is split again sm:grid-cols-[0.85fr_1.15fr] between the art and the radar. At max-w-6xl with a sidebar, that leaves about 250px for the radar. The margin of 44px on each side is not enough for the longest label, 'Family & Future' (about 80px), at the left axis position, so recharts draws it past the SVG's left edge and the SVG clips it.
